title: InterceptorExecutionOrder
description: Controls how a page interceptor runs relative to the matching entity interceptor for the same command and type.
markdownDescription: Use on page interceptors only. `EntityFirst` (default when omitted) runs the entity interceptor before the page interceptor. `PageFirst` runs the page interceptor first. `SkipEntity` skips the entity interceptor for the same command/type slot. This setting applies to `Pre` and `Post` interceptors only; `Replace` interceptors use a separate pipeline and should omit `entityExecutionOrder`.
enumDescriptions: Run the entity interceptor before the page interceptor.
